capabilityMatrix.hardware: Apple silicon Mac; game supports macOS native full-screen mode
capabilityMatrix.entitlement: No dedicated entitlement is stated in the reviewed source; this is not a claim that all application permissions are unnecessary.
capabilityMatrix.api: System-managed Game Mode; game menu or Metal Performance HUD for observed state
capabilityMatrix.processScope: The recognized full-screen game process; host eligibility does not establish child-process activation
inputConditions: Launch an application bundle through normal application launch; macOS26 notes document that directly spawning the binary from Terminal does not activate Game Mode.
Enter native macOS full-screen; user can disable Game Mode.
capabilityMatrix.verification: Observe Game Mode on/off in game menu/HUD for the target application, then A/B test identical replay, frame interval percentiles, GPU time and input latency where instrumented. No automatic speedup claim.

capabilityMatrix.hardware: System Game Mode eligibility still applies
capabilityMatrix.entitlement: Info.plist Boolean; not a code-signing entitlement
capabilityMatrix.processScope: The application bundle declaring the key
inputConditions: YES makes Game Mode available; NO opts out; omitted key may prevent activation.
Plist presence and OS version are not proof of activation.
capabilityMatrix.verification: Inspect built bundle key and observe target-app Game Mode on/off under native full-screen.

capabilityMatrix.hardware: Current Apple metadata lists iOS/iPadOS only; do not present this legacy key as a macOS14/15 requirement
capabilityMatrix.processScope: The application bundle declaring the key
inputConditions: Introduced iOS/iPadOS18.0; deprecated18.6; Apple deprecationSummary explicitly directs LSSupportsGameMode.
capabilityMatrix.verification: Read current official platform metadata and deprecationSummary; no macOS availability is listed.

capabilityMatrix.hardware: A selected MTLDevice for which MTLFXSpatialScalerDescriptor.supportsDevice returns true
capabilityMatrix.entitlement: No dedicated entitlement is stated in the reviewed source; this is not a claim that all application permissions are unnecessary.
capabilityMatrix.processScope: The process creating and encoding the scaler for its selected Metal device
inputConditions: Successful non-nil scaler creation.
Color texture format/dimensions and scaler-reported texture usages are valid.
Output texture uses private storage mode and correct output dimensions.
capabilityMatrix.verification: Encode real scaler workload, confirm command-buffer completion without error, copy private output through an appropriate staging resource for image assertions, and compare fixed-scene quality/GPU time. HUD can report actual scaling method and resolutions.

capabilityMatrix.hardware: A selected MTLDevice for which MTLFXTemporalScalerDescriptor.supportsDevice returns true
capabilityMatrix.entitlement: No dedicated entitlement is stated in the reviewed source; this is not a claim that all application permissions are unnecessary.
capabilityMatrix.processScope: The process supplying the renderer history and encoding the scaler
inputConditions: Successful non-nil scaler creation.
Correct color, depth, motion-vector, jitter, reset/history semantics, dimensions and formats; caller supplies scene data.
Private output texture and scaler-reported texture usage requirements.
capabilityMatrix.verification: Execute multiple controlled frames, verify output and GPU completion, compare artifact/quality stability and GPU time to the same unscaled or native-resolution scene. A device-support Boolean alone proves no effect.

capabilityMatrix.hardware: No narrower model list stated in reviewed API source
capabilityMatrix.entitlement: No dedicated entitlement is stated in the reviewed source; this is not a claim that all application permissions are unnecessary.
capabilityMatrix.processScope: Current process observes system thermal state and adapts its own work
inputConditions: Read thermalState before registering.
Use default notification center; SDK states delivery occurs on global dispatch queue.
Read current state on notification; serialize mutations in the consumer.
capabilityMatrix.verification: Test notification/state sampling path and deterministic transitions via injected values; distinguish simulation from actual hardware thermal events.

capabilityMatrix.capability: Low Power Mode state and notification
capabilityMatrix.hardware: No narrower model list stated in reviewed API source; Low Power Mode is distinct from battery percentage
capabilityMatrix.entitlement: No dedicated entitlement is stated in the reviewed source; this is not a claim that all application permissions are unnecessary.
capabilityMatrix.processScope: Current process observes device power state and adapts its own work
inputConditions: Re-read isLowPowerModeEnabled after notification.
Default notification center; SDK states delivery occurs on global dispatch queue.
capabilityMatrix.verification: Exercise deterministic injected transitions; test a real system Low Power Mode toggle only when that device/system mode is available.

capabilityMatrix.hardware: No dedicated hardware constraint in reviewed API source
capabilityMatrix.entitlement: No dedicated entitlement is stated in the reviewed source; this is not a claim that all application permissions are unnecessary.
capabilityMatrix.processScope: Default QoS for operations added to the current-process queue
inputConditions: Explicit operation QoS supersedes the queue default.
Underlying dispatch queue QoS overrides operation queue QoS; the main queue default cannot be changed.
capabilityMatrix.verification: Assert assigned queue QoS and reversible resource-policy transitions; benchmark representative work separately. QoS is scheduling intent, not a process-wide or cross-process acceleration guarantee.

capabilityMatrix.hardware: Applicable devices; reviewed entitlement page does not enumerate exact Mac models or expose a device-support query
capabilityMatrix.entitlement: com.apple.developer.sustained-execution = true in the code-signed target app
capabilityMatrix.api: Signing entitlement; no dynamic switch API established by reviewed source
capabilityMatrix.processScope: The entitled app over its lifecycle; no inferred inheritance by a separately launched child game
inputConditions: System limits burst performance to sustain consistent performance over time.
For devices without the feature, app workload settings remain necessary.
capabilityMatrix.verification: Inspect final signed target entitlement; perform long-duration identical-workload A/B measurements. The host module must not claim observed activation without signing/device/runtime evidence.

capabilityMatrix.hardware: Mac with Apple silicon; confirm selected device supportsFamily(.metal4)
capabilityMatrix.entitlement: No dedicated entitlement is stated in the reviewed source; this is not a claim that all application permissions are unnecessary.
capabilityMatrix.processScope: Current rendering process and its selected MTLDevice
inputConditions: Availability gate and selected-device family check.
Metal4 queue/resources/encoding requirements; factories may fail.
capabilityMatrix.verification: Query actual device family and create/execute a representative Metal4 command path before claiming runtime use. Older Metal path remains fallback.

capabilityMatrix.hardware: Underlying scaler/interpolator device support and valid inputs still apply
capabilityMatrix.entitlement: No dedicated entitlement is stated in the reviewed source; this is not a claim that all application permissions are unnecessary.
capabilityMatrix.api: Temporal output-resolution motion vectors / jittered motion vectors / content offsets / reactive-mask usage; frame-interpolator distortion and previous-color controls
capabilityMatrix.processScope: Current renderer supplying the optional data and enabling the corresponding MetalFX feature
inputConditions: These are selected SDK-confirmed additions, not an inventory of every macOS27 capability.
Output-resolution motion vector flag requires vectors at output resolution; jittered-motion flag uses per-frame jitter offsets.
Interpolator distortion/previous-color paths require corresponding valid textures and temporal inputs.
capabilityMatrix.verification: Availability-check specific members and compile against target SDK; actual feature/effect requires corresponding rendering inputs and executed GPU workload.

capabilityMatrix.hardware: Apple silicon Mac; independently query the selected MTLDevice with spatial supportsMetal4FX
capabilityMatrix.entitlement: No dedicated entitlement is stated in the reviewed API source; this does not establish permissions for an arbitrary target application.
capabilityMatrix.processScope: The current renderer using its selected device, MTL4Compiler and MTL4CommandBuffer
inputConditions: Non-nil Metal4FX scaler creation; correct color input, dimensions, formats and required usages; private output.
Ordinary spatial supportsDevice or supportsFamily(.metal4) alone does not establish Metal4FX support.
capabilityMatrix.verification: Support query is measured. Creation, Metal4 command submission, output checks and representative-workload effects remain not tested; renderer must retain an older scaling path.

capabilityMatrix.hardware: Apple silicon Mac; independently query the selected MTLDevice with temporal supportsMetal4FX
capabilityMatrix.entitlement: No dedicated entitlement is stated in the reviewed API source; this does not establish permissions for an arbitrary target application.
capabilityMatrix.processScope: The current renderer supplying temporal history and encoding MTL4CommandBuffer
inputConditions: Non-nil Metal4FX scaler creation; valid color/depth/motion, jitter/reset/history, dimensions and formats; private output.
Ordinary temporal support is not a substitute for Metal4FX support.
capabilityMatrix.verification: Support query is measured. Metal4FX creation, multi-frame execution, image/temporal validation and effects remain not tested; retain an older rendering route.

capabilityMatrix.capability: Frame interpolation with ordinary Metal command buffers
capabilityMatrix.hardware: Selected MTLDevice must pass MTLFXFrameInterpolatorDescriptor.supportsDevice; no narrower Mac model list was established by the reviewed API source
capabilityMatrix.entitlement: No dedicated entitlement is stated in the reviewed API source; this does not establish permissions for an arbitrary target application.
capabilityMatrix.processScope: The current rendering process using MTLCommandBuffer
inputConditions: Non-nil interpolator creation, valid current/previous color, depth, motion, camera/time/history inputs, dimensions and usages; private output.
On macOS27 requiresPrevColorTexture defaults true; setting false selects interpolator-managed previous color.
capabilityMatrix.verification: Support query is measured. Create and execute at least two controlled rendered frames, verify intermediate output, motion artifacts, frame intervals and input latency before claiming actual use or effect. Current creation/execution/effect are not tested; fall back to no interpolation.

capabilityMatrix.capability: Frame interpolation with Metal4FX command buffers
capabilityMatrix.hardware: Apple silicon Mac; independently query selected MTLDevice with interpolator supportsMetal4FX
capabilityMatrix.entitlement: No dedicated entitlement is stated in the reviewed API source; this does not establish permissions for an arbitrary target application.
capabilityMatrix.processScope: The current renderer using MTL4Compiler and MTL4CommandBuffer
inputConditions: Non-nil Metal4FX interpolator creation and the ordinary interpolator input/private-output requirements.
Each alternate route requires its own support and factory checks.
capabilityMatrix.verification: Support query is measured. Metal4FX creation, submission, intermediate-frame output and effects are not tested; renderer may select a separately validated ordinary interpolation route or disable interpolation.

limitations: No claim that the selected source set covers every macOS27 API or capability.
Absence of an entitlement requirement in a reviewed API source is not evidence that arbitrary target applications need no permissions.
Sustained Execution Mode exact supported Mac models and a public activation/status query are not established by the reviewed entitlement page.
Runtime effects require target-application and representative-workload evidence; support queries and plist declarations are separate evidence layers.
